create_IPCWeightTransferEngine: create an IPCWeightTransferEngine instance with WeightTransferConfig and ParallelConfig for CUDA IPC weight transfer
run_trainer_send_weights_ray: run trainer_send_weights in ray mode to send model parameters via Ray RPC to an LLM handle
run_trainer_send_weights_http: run trainer_send_weights in http mode to POST pickled IPC handles to a vLLM server URL
receive_weights_from_ipc: receive weights via CUDA IPC handles and load them incrementally into the model to avoid OOM
validate_IPCWeightTransferUpdateInfo: validate IPCWeightTransferUpdateInfo with matching names, dtype_names, shapes, and ipc_handles arrays
